violations.description: Test failures are ignored by continue-on-error in CI workflow
violations.evidence: continue-on-error: true on the pytest test step in .github/workflows/ci.yml
violations.recommendation: Remove continue-on-error: true so that test failures correctly fail the CI pipeline.

violations.description: Hardcoded machine-specific absolute path in source code
violations.recommendation: Use configurable paths, environment variables, or temporary directories instead of hardcoded user-specific paths.
